name: WILL,Co.,Ltd.
summary: WILL Co., Ltd. produces and distributes finely machined parts worldwide using CNC lathe technology. Its products include electronic parts such as probe pins for semiconductor testing equipment and connectors, automotive and hydraulic components, and medical device parts for hearing aids, dental tools and endoscopes. It supplies electronics, automotive and healthcare equipment makers. Dating from 1993, it has its base in Seika, Japan.
